title: Sorting Algorithms: Speed Is Found In The Minds of People - Andrei Alexandrescu - CppCon 2019
summary: Andrei Alexandrescu's CppCon 2019 talk revisits sorting, showing how branchless tricks, hybrid strategies and a cost metric can speed up std::sort-style algorithms on modern hardware.
why: HN recommends it as an entertaining talk that starts simple and goes deep on practical performance optimization.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: At first he is just showing simple stuff, but stay with it, he goes deep.
